item.title: OpenAI Releases Images 2.6, Enabling Native GIF Generation in ChatGPT
item.description:

item.title: OpenAI Uses GPT-5.5 to Identify Over 1000 Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities
item.description:
OpenAI demonstrates the capability of its GPT-5.5 Cyber model in automated security research by systematically identifying and validating thousands of candidate Linux kernel vulnerabilities. The process successfully reproduced 1,724 dynamic vulnerabilities and generated 948 local privilege escalation (LPE) exploits, aiming to enhance infrastructure security by accelerating vulnerability discovery and patch development with AI.

原文标题：OpenAI 利用 GPT-5.5 发现千余 Linux 内核漏洞

item.title: Apple Cuts Internal AI Budgets, Reducing Engineer Daily Caps by 33%
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that Apple is significantly cutting internal budgets for employee AI usage to curb rising costs. Daily token consumption caps for some engineers have dropped from $300 to $200, with plans to reduce them further to $100 or lower. This move reflects a broader industry shift from encouraging large-scale experimentation to rigorous cost-benefit analysis, mirroring similar actions by Microsoft, Tesla, and others.

原文标题：苹果收紧员工 AI 预算 部分工程师日额度降 33%

item.description:

A key highlight is that Arm's dedicated AGI CPU has secured multiple customer orders with first commercial deliveries expected in Q4 FY2027, alongside a doubling of data center royalty revenue.

item.title: Uber Earnings Reveal Minimal Adoption of AI Agent Bookings
item.description:
Uber's Q3 earnings reveal extremely low adoption of AI agents for ride-hailing and food delivery. During the Halloween week, out of ~320 million trips/orders, only 4 rides and 500 food orders were initiated by AI agents. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi acknowledged the traction is 'very early and limited' but noted that all major AI system companies are in talks with Uber.

item.title: Stanford Study: NVIDIA B200 Delivers 9x Energy Efficiency vs AMD MI350X
item.description:
Stanford researchers introduced the 'Joules-to-GDP' metric to quantify the economic return of AI chips relative to energy consumption in real-world professional tasks. The study found that when running identical models, the NVIDIA B200 delivered over 4x the dollar value and 9x the expert time saved per unit of energy compared to the AMD MI350X. This highlights how hardware selection critically determines AI economic efficiency under power constraints.

原文标题：斯坦福研究：NVIDIA B200 能效比 AMD MI350X 高 9 倍

Why it matters：提供了具体的芯片能效对比数据和新颖的经济评估指标，对算力选型具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Stanford Proposes J2G Framework Showing Small Models Yield Higher Economic Value per Joule
item.description:
Stanford researchers introduced the 'Joules-to-GDP' (J2G) framework to quantify the net economic value generated per joule of energy consumed by AI tasks. Experiments on the GDPval benchmark revealed that smaller open-source models (e.g., Gemma 4 31B) deliver significantly higher economic returns per unit of energy compared to larger models, despite lower absolute output. The study highlights that scaling up hardware often yields diminishing speed gains relative to energy costs, offering new efficiency-based criteria for model selection in power-constrained environments.

原文标题：斯坦福提出 J2G 框架 揭示小模型能效经济价值更高

Why it matters：提出了量化的能效-经济价值评估新范式，数据详实，对当前高耗能大模型趋势具有直接的纠偏与指导意义。

item.description:
